releases.name: v0.3.0 - three cooperating skills, a clean reading copy, three hard gates
releases.notes:
v0.3.0 — three cooperating skills, a clean reading copy, three hard gates

This release turns the single research skill into a small family: the core deep
research skill plus two optional capability skills it hands work off to, with a
cleaner deliverable and a stricter delivery gate. It is the full diff from
v0.2.0.

## Three cooperating skills

- **`meld-deepresearch`** — the core research / evidence / citation loop. Still
 Python-standard-library only.
- **`meld-da`** — an Excel / spreadsheet data-analysis workflow (reading,
 cleaning, filtering, aggregation, statistics, charts, export), adapted from
 SenseNova-Skills' `sn-da-excel-workflow` (MIT) and reworked for portable use.
 Its Python packages are optional; without them it degrades to the built-in
 zero-dependency reader.
- **`meld-search-academic`** — academic search, paper full-text and section
 reading, and citation-tree tracing across arXiv, Semantic Scholar, Google
 Scholar, PubMed, Crossref, OpenAlex, SSRN, Wikipedia and more, adapted from
 `sn-search-academic` (MIT). Its browser-crawler tier is optional and degrades
 to the official APIs and then to generic search.

Cross-skill hand-offs are documented in `references/protocol.md` section 2a:
local table files plus analysis route to `meld-da`; academic, scientific or
historical subjects route the scholarly layer through `meld-search-academic`.

en.headline: 3 own commits and 4 automated commits across 2 repos
en.summary: On 2026-10-06, `sogeisetsu` made **3 own commits** in `sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch`, plus 4 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. The three own commits in `sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` covered a release chore for `v0.3.1`, a docs update adding high-intent search terms to skill descriptions, and a CI fix making the academic degrade test dependency-aware (draw gate 3). No pull requests, reviews, or issues were opened or closed by the user that day. In `iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI`, `goworm` commented on and then closed issue #458 ("OpenCode v2 integration: fix skills install path + add mcp target"), noting the skills-side fix had already landed in 1.0.140 via #254 and that `officecli skills opencode` writes to `~/.config/opencode/skills/`. One release was published: `v0.3.0` of `sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch`, which split the single research skill into a family of three cooperating skills (`meld-deepresearch`, `meld-da`, and a third), added a cleaner reading copy, and introduced three hard delivery gates.

releaseNotes.summary: v0.3.0 turns the single research skill into a family of three cooperating skills: the core `meld-deepresearch` (Python stdlib only), `meld-da` for Excel/spreadsheet data analysis adapted from SenseNova-Skills' `sn-da-excel-workflow` (MIT), and a third skill. It also delivers a cleaner reading copy and three hard delivery gates, as the full diff from v0.2.0.
